full_prompt_en: A close expressive oil portrait shows a bearded man from just above the brows to the shoulders, his gaze steady and slightly turned toward the left. The face fills nearly the whole frame, with only a narrow off-white strip of background visible at the left. Instead of smooth skin, the forehead, nose, cheeks, and under-eye planes are constructed from thick, discrete strokes of pale peach, ochre, coral, mauve, cream, and gray-blue. The eyes retain comparatively precise pupils and dark rims, making them an immediate focal point amid the broken color. A strong green-black brow and beard organize the lower and upper dark areas, their blocky strokes crossing into teal, olive, and cool gray. The nose projects through stacked warm pink and orange facets; small violet shadows set off its side and the eye sockets. Hair at the upper edge is a turbulent cluster of dark green and charcoal marks, partially cropped out of the canvas. Light reaches the broad upper cheek and forehead from the left, while lower planes grow cooler and denser. The paint appears thickly applied, with ridges, dragged edges, and occasional gaps of white ground between marks. Short directional strokes turn around each form, giving the image energy without abandoning recognizable features. The crop is unusually intimate, pressing the expression toward the viewer; the unpainted pale edge keeps the heavy color from feeling sealed. Overall the work is restless and tactile, with an emotional presence built through blunt paint handling and complex warm-cool shifts.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅近距离表现性油画肖像呈现一位蓄须男子，从眉上到肩部入画，目光稳定且稍偏左。面孔几乎填满全幅，左侧只见狭窄米白背景。额头、鼻、脸颊和眼下平面并非平滑皮肤，而是由厚而离散的浅桃、赭、珊瑚、淡紫、奶油与灰蓝笔触建成。眼睛保留较准确的瞳孔与暗边，使它们在破碎色彩中立即成为焦点。强烈绿黑眉毛与胡须组织上下暗区，块状笔触穿插青绿、橄榄与冷灰。鼻子从叠加的暖粉与橙色切面中向前凸出，小块紫影衬出侧面与眼窝。上边缘头发是深绿和炭黑笔迹的翻涌簇，部分被画布裁去。光从左侧触到宽阔上脸颊和前额，较低平面则更冷更密。颜料看起来厚涂，可见隆起、拖拽边缘，以及笔痕间偶尔露出的白底。短方向笔围绕各形体转动，使图像充满能量，又没有丢失可辨面貌。裁切格外亲近，把表情推到观者面前；未着色浅边使沉重色彩不至于封闭。整件作品不安分且可触，凭直率颜料处理与复杂冷暖转移建立情绪存在。
style_prompt_en: Expressive impasto oil painting constructs recognizable volume from short, blunt, separately visible color facets rather than smooth blended gradients. Pale peach, ochre, coral, mauve, and cream meet cool gray-blue, teal, olive, and charcoal in restless warm-cool shifts. Thick ridges, dragged edges, and small gaps of unpainted off-white ground keep the surface physical. A few precise dark focal marks anchor the otherwise broken field, while larger green-black masses establish weight at the upper and lower edges. Light falls across selected warm planes from one side, and the shadow side thickens into cooler, denser strokes. Directions change as the facets turn around underlying form, giving energetic structure to the marks. Cropping is close, with a narrow pale margin allowing the color mass to breathe. Edges alternate between sharp paint cuts and ragged overlap, and the overall value contrast remains strong even amid varied hues. The result is immediate, tactile, emotionally charged, and visibly made from paint.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性厚涂油画以短促、直接、各自可见的彩色切面建立可辨体积，而非平滑融合渐层。浅桃、赭、珊瑚、淡紫和奶油与冷灰蓝、青绿、橄榄、炭黑相遇，冷暖转移躁动。厚重隆起、拖拽边缘与少量未涂米白底的间隙让表面具有实体感。少数精确的暗焦点笔迹锚住其余破碎色场，较大绿黑色块在上下边缘建立重量。光从一侧落在选择性暖平面，背光侧加密成更冷更厚的笔触。方向随切面绕底层形体转变，使笔迹有充满能量的结构。裁切近，狭窄浅色边给色块留出呼吸。边缘在锐利颜料切口与粗糙叠压间交替，即使色相多变，整体明暗对比仍强。结果直接、可触、富情绪张力，并明显由颜料构成。
theme_en: A close view of a bearded man rendered in thick color facets
theme_zh: 以厚重彩色切面绘制的蓄须男子近景
name: Ben Quilty
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
